pages.title: Baton
pages.text:
Commands a single doll.

• Right-click a doll → select it
• After selection, right-click a block to set corner A, then corner B (work area rectangle)
• Shift-right-click the doll → clear work area
• Max work area side: 64 blocks
• In Melee/Archer mode, right-click a mob to force-target it

pages.title: Remote
pages.text:
Right-click anywhere to open the control panel. Lists all living dolls. Switch modes and toggle Follow for all at once.

Baton = precise single-doll control, on-site work area setup.
Remote = global management of all dolls.

Work areas apply only to Woodcutting/Farming/Mining modes.
